Confidence.description: Specification 7.4. Only ``medium`` and ``high`` may become templates.
Confidence.title: Confidence

ControlType.description:
Additive since schema 0.2.1: ``PASSWORD``, ``FILE``, and ``HIDDEN``.

Specification 7.2 forbids capturing the values of these controls, and a type
that cannot be named cannot be checked. A reader written against the earlier
member list must treat an unknown control type as ``other``.
ControlType.title: ControlType

FormActionKind.description:
Where a form submits, expressed without the content of where.

``page_signature`` needs to tell a search form from a delete form, and the two
differ in where they submit. It must not learn the search term, so only the
origin relationship is recorded here; the path arrives separately as a
normalized route pattern, which drops query values by construction.
FormActionKind.title: FormActionKind

LabelSource.description:
Specification 8.1 accessible-name priority, highest first.

The order is the specification's, not the DOM's convenience: a wrapping
``<label>`` outranks ``aria-labelledby``. Phase 0 had these two transposed and
ended with ``title``, which specification 8.1 does not list at all; the eighth
source is a nearby heading or fieldset legend.
LabelSource.title: LabelSource

LocatorCandidate.description:
One way to find an element again.

``key`` holds the matching value for the candidate kind: the ``id`` value, the
control ``name``, the accessible name, the label text, or a structural path
rooted at the nearest landmark or form ancestor. A structural path may carry
tag-index information, but execution must never fall back to a global
nth-child-only path, a bounding box, a screenshot coordinate, or a selector
supplied by an external agent.
LocatorCandidate.title: LocatorCandidate

LocatorChain.description:
All applicable candidates for one element, plus the primary candidate.

Re-resolution (specification 7.7) walks ``candidates`` in priority order and
accepts only an exactly-one match. Zero matches and ambiguous matches both
continue to the next candidate; the closest element is never chosen.
LocatorChain.title: LocatorChain

LocatorKind.description:
Candidate kinds in priority order (specification 7.6).

Lower value means higher priority, so a chain sorts by ``kind`` directly.
LocatorKind.title: LocatorKind

description:
One interactive element eligible under specification 8.2.

``value`` carries a current control value only when it is safe to record.
Password values, payment-card values, security codes, hidden authentication
tokens, and file-input paths are never captured (specification 7.2), so the
extractor leaves ``value`` as ``None`` for those controls rather than storing
a redacted placeholder.

The ``form_*`` fields describe where a submit sends the page, not what it
sends. They exist because unique re-resolution is not semantic equivalence: a
submit replaced by a different-purpose button keeping the same id, accessible
name, and in-form structure still re-resolves to exactly one element, and only
the destination separates the two. ``form_action_route`` is already normalized
when it arrives, so no query value is ever held here.
title: NormalizedElement
